context.person: A person using a music subscription service
context.user_goal: Review the pause or cancel before resumption if continued billing is not wanted.

product_state.preceding_state: The subscriber paused a monthly plan for two billing cycles.
product_state.current_state: No charge will occur on October 2 or November 2. Offline downloads stop working when the current period ends September 30.
known_facts: No charge will occur on October 2 or November 2.
Offline downloads stop working when the current period ends September 30.
Billing resumes automatically on December 2 unless canceled.
forbidden_claims: Offline downloads remain playable during the pause.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product confirmation so the person can understand subscription pause confirmation, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Cancel the subscription before automatic resumption.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Access changes after September 30 and billing resumes December 2.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Review the pause or cancel before resumption if continued billing is not wanted.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
